patterns.description: Inspect outbound packets for a TLS ClientHello whose SNI matches a blocklist; emit a synthetic RST when matched.
Inspect outbound UDP datagrams for QUIC Initial long headers with matching SNI/ALPN; drop the matched datagram.
Inspect outbound packets for a TLS ClientHello whose SNI matches a blocklist; rewrite the ClientHello so the handshake terminates at a sinkhole.
Accumulate outbound bytes per flow; after the threshold is crossed, drop all subsequent packets to the configured destination.
Match any outbound packet whose payload exceeds the configured MTU threshold; fragment or drop in live mode.
